releaseNotes: Chrome Interaction Recovery: fixes a case where the Job Timer could be visible but non-interactive because a stale timer root caused the extension to skip the MAIN-world timer runtime. v0.7.1 now treats the runtime global as authoritative, removes stale dead timer DOM before reinjection, verifies the runtime after boot, and restores the root-only observer rule for the Glass presentation layer. Edge and Chrome continue to ship from the same MV3 source with Solid/Glass finishes, website themes, dark-theme logo, Job Workspace controls, archives, and CSV backup/restore.
